questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'A leopard cannot change its ___'?
explanation: Spots is correct - S-P-O-T-S. A leopard cannot change its spots means a person cannot change their fundamental nature.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'Bite the hand that ___'?
explanation: Feeds is correct - F-E-E-D-S. Bite the hand that feeds means to harm someone who helps you. Double E.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'The devil is in the ___'?
explanation: Details is correct - D-E-T-A-I-L-S. The devil is in the details means problems arise from small ignored factors.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'Every ___' meaning a place in time?
explanation: Epoch is correct - E-P-O-C-H. Every epoch refers to every age or era in history.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'A watched pot never ___'?
explanation: Boils is correct - B-O-I-L-S. A watched pot never boils means time seems to pass more slowly when you are waiting.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'All roads lead to ___'?
explanation: Rome is correct - R-O-M-E. All roads lead to Rome means there are many ways to achieve the same result.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'Give credit where credit is ___'?
explanation: Due is correct - D-U-E. Give credit where credit is due means acknowledge someone for what they have done.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'A house divided against itself cannot ___'?
explanation: Stand is correct - S-T-A-N-D. A house divided cannot stand means unity is essential for survival.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'Fortune favours the ___'?
explanation: Brave is correct - B-R-A-V-E. Fortune favours the brave means those who take risks are more likely to succeed.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'A friend in need is a friend ___'?
explanation: Indeed is correct - I-N-D-E-E-D. A friend in need is a friend indeed means a true friend helps in difficult times. Double E.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'Absence makes the heart grow ___'?
explanation: Fonder is correct - F-O-N-D-E-R. Absence makes the heart grow fonder means we appreciate people more when they are away.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'Let sleeping dogs ___'?
explanation: Lie is correct - L-I-E. Let sleeping dogs lie means do not stir up old problems.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'Burn the candle at both ___'?
explanation: Ends is correct - E-N-D-S. Burn the candle at both ends means to work excessively hard.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'Out of the frying pan and into the ___'?
explanation: Fire is correct - F-I-R-E. Out of the frying pan and into the fire means moving from a bad situation to a worse one.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'You cannot make an ___'?
explanation: Omelette is correct - O-M-E-L-E-T-T-E. You cannot make an omelette without breaking eggs means you cannot achieve something without some negative consequences. Double T.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'Necessity is the mother of ___'?
explanation: Invention is correct - I-N-V-E-N-T-I-O-N. Necessity is the mother of invention means need drives creativity.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'The proof is in the ___'?
explanation: Pudding is correct - P-U-D-D-I-N-G. The proof is in the pudding means the true value of something can only be judged when tried. Double D.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'Every dog has its ___'?
explanation: Day is correct - D-A-Y. Every dog has its day means everyone has a moment of success or luck.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'The squeaky wheel gets the ___'?
explanation: Grease is correct - G-R-E-A-S-E. The squeaky wheel gets the grease means those who complain loudest get what they want.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'Better late than ___'?
explanation: Never is correct - N-E-V-E-R. Better late than never means it is better to do something late than not at all.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'Blood is thicker than ___'?
explanation: Water is correct - W-A-T-E-R. Blood is thicker than water means family bonds are stronger than other relationships.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'Discretion is the better part of ___'?
explanation: Valour is correct - V-A-L-O-U-R. Discretion is the better part of valour means it is wiser to be cautious than reckless.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'The road to ___ is paved with good intentions'?
explanation: Perdition is correct - P-E-R-D-I-T-I-O-N. The road to perdition is paved with good intentions means good intentions do not always lead to good outcomes.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'He who ___  last laughs longest'?
explanation: Laughs is correct - L-A-U-G-H-S. He who laughs last laughs longest means the final victor has the most satisfaction.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'A penny for your ___'?
explanation: Thoughts is correct - T-H-O-U-G-H-T-S. A penny for your thoughts means tell me what you are thinking.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'When the cat is away the mice will ___'?
explanation: Play is correct - P-L-A-Y. When the cat is away the mice will play means people take liberties when authority is absent.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'Clothes make the ___'?
explanation: Man is correct - M-A-N. Clothes make the man means appearance affects how others judge us.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'The pen is mightier than the ___'?
explanation: Sword is correct - S-W-O-R-D. The pen is mightier than the sword means ideas and words are more powerful than weapons.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'Ignorance is ___'?
explanation: Bliss is correct - B-L-I-S-S. Ignorance is bliss means not knowing about problems makes life happier. Double S.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'To ___ on thin ice'?
explanation: Tread is correct - T-R-E-A-D. To tread on thin ice means to be in a risky or dangerous situation.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'Speak of the devil and he shall ___'?
explanation: Appear is correct - A-P-P-E-A-R. Speak of the devil means the person being discussed has just arrived. Double P.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'A rolling stone gathers no ___'?
explanation: Moss is correct - M-O-S-S. A rolling stone gathers no moss means a person who never settles builds nothing lasting. Double S.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'The buck stops ___'?
explanation: Here is correct - H-E-R-E. The buck stops here means this person takes final responsibility.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'Too many cooks spoil the ___'?
explanation: Broth is correct - B-R-O-T-H. Too many cooks spoil the broth means too many people involved causes problems.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'Cut to the ___'?
explanation: Chase is correct - C-H-A-S-E. Cut to the chase means get to the point without wasting time.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'Pull yourself up by your ___'?
explanation: Bootstraps is correct - B-O-O-T-S-T-R-A-P-S. Pull yourself up by your bootstraps means to improve your situation through your own effort.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'What goes around comes ___'?
explanation: Around is correct - A-R-O-U-N-D. What goes around comes around means your actions will eventually return to you.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'Once bitten, twice ___'?
explanation: Shy is correct - S-H-Y. Once bitten twice shy means after a bad experience you are more cautious.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'The truth will set you ___'?
explanation: Free is correct - F-R-E-E. The truth will set you free means honesty brings liberation. Double E.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'Keep your friends close and your ___ closer'?
explanation: Enemies is correct - E-N-E-M-I-E-S. Keep your friends close and your enemies closer means be aware of those who oppose you.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'The greatest ___ is the one you have not taken'?
explanation: Risk is correct - R-I-S-K. The greatest risk is the one you have not taken means being overly cautious has its own dangers.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'Still waters run ___'?
explanation: Deep is correct - D-E-E-P. Still waters run deep means a quiet person often has much depth of thought. Double E.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'Hindsight is ___'?
explanation: Twenty-twenty is correct - T-W-E-N-T-Y-T-W-E-N-T-Y. Hindsight is twenty-twenty means it is easy to understand events after they have happened.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'The best things in life are ___'?
explanation: Free is correct - F-R-E-E. The best things in life are free means the most valuable things cannot be bought. Double E.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'If it is not broken do not ___ it'?
explanation: Fix is correct - F-I-X. If it is not broken do not fix it means do not change something that already works well.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'Curiosity killed the ___'?
explanation: Cat is correct - C-A-T. Curiosity killed the cat means being too inquisitive can lead to trouble.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'Burn your ___'?
explanation: Bridges is correct - B-R-I-D-G-E-S. Burn your bridges means to destroy any possibility of returning or rebuilding a relationship.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'The grass is always greener on the other ___'?
explanation: Side is correct - S-I-D-E. The grass is always greener on the other side means people always think others have it better.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling to complete: 'Actions speak louder than ___'?
explanation: Words is correct - W-O-R-D-S. Actions speak louder than words means what you do matters more than what you say.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word meaning a short traditional saying expressing general truth?
explanation: Proverb is correct - P-R-O-V-E-R-B. A proverb is a short well-known saying expressing a general truth or piece of advice.
